text.en:
Section 2 of Presidential Decree No. 454 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 2. Notwithstanding the provisions of Section 3 hereof, the initial adjustments of contract prices of
projects covered by this decree shall not be earlier than six (6) months after the date of bidding. Readjustments
on the unit prices shall be made every six months thereafter."
Done in the City of Manila this 19th day of March, in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
